about.title: About Minevam Kigobe
about.paragraph1: Founded in 2004 in the heart of Bujumbura, Minevam Kigobe Church began with a small group of believers committed to sharing God's love throughout Burundi. Over two decades, we have grown into a vibrant community of over 1,200 members united by faith, hope, and love.
about.paragraph2: Our church is rooted in the belief that every person has immeasurable worth and potential. We strive to be a place where all are welcome, all are valued, and all can experience transformation through the power of God's Word and community.
about.missionDesc: To love God wholeheartedly and serve our community with compassion, bringing transformation to every life we touch in Bujumbura and beyond.
about.visionDesc: To be a beacon of hope and light for all of Burundi — a church that raises disciples who impact their generation and leave a lasting spiritual legacy.
about.valuesDesc: Faith, Family, Fellowship, and Service. We believe in the power of community united by love, worship, and a shared commitment to serve one another.

ministries.title: Our Ministries
ministries.subtitle: There's a place for everyone at Minevam Kigobe. Find your community and start serving today.
ministries.choirDesc: Our dynamic praise ministry leads the congregation in vibrant, inspired worship. The choir meets every Saturday for practice.
ministries.youthDesc: A dynamic space for youth ages 13–35 to grow in faith, develop leaders, and live their faith daily.
ministries.outreachDesc: We touch the most vulnerable in Bujumbura — orphans, widows, and homeless — through practical love and evangelism.
ministries.kidsDesc: A safe, joyful environment where children ages 0–12 discover God's love through stories, songs, and creative activities.
ministries.missionsDesc: Carrying the Gospel message beyond the church walls — into the streets, villages, and provinces of Burundi.
ministries.sundaySchoolDesc: In-depth biblical teaching for adults — thematic studies, cell groups, and training for committed disciples.
